title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 6ft and 10ft Long PD USB-C Cables Fast Charge TYPE-C to TYPE-C Cord Power Wire USB-C to USB-C
description:
USB Type-C to Type-C Cable - 6 Feet (Approximately 2 Meters) and 10 feet (3 meter) - 
The USB cable provides a Type-C connector at one end and Type-C connector on other end for quick and easy data transfers. The cable supports up to 65W - 3 Amps of power output for powering and fast charging. For backup charging, it can be used in conjunction with any USB Type-C phone charger. It can also quickly transfer music, photos, and data to and from a laptop (with type-C port) with transfer speeds up to 5 Gbps. The cable’s USB Type-C connector offers a user-friendly reversible design that makes it possible to easily connect the cable to a device. No more wondering which way faces up when plugging it in.
